candidates.name: Jamee Decio
candidates.info: Jamee Decio is a strong advocate for energy and water safeguards for data centers, and affordable domestic renewable energy to strengthen national security.
candidates.race_sheet_info:
Jamee Decio, a Notre Dame-educated attorney, is a strong advocate for energy and water safeguards for data centers, and affordable domestic renewable energy to strengthen national security.

She has a detailed data center priority:

  • Require data centers to fully fund their own grid and utility infrastructure upgrades, and legally prevent utilities from shifting those costs onto residential customers.
  • Establish agricultural and residential water rights. Data center servers must be the first thing to shut down, if a farmer’s well or a town’s water supply are threatened.
  • No more secrecy and backroom deals. Ban the use of nondisclosure agreements (NDAs) by any public entity negotiating with data center developers.
  • Advocate for local governments to maintain zoning authority, ensuring that local residents have the final say on site selection.

Decio also has an affordable energy priority to address:

  • Geopolitical chaos driving up energy costs.
  • Strengthening national security by investing in advanced power grid technology and domestic renewable energy.

Questionaire Responses

Supports policies that ensure greater public transparency and local control of planned AI data center projects, as well as requirements that AI data center operations do not increase Hoosier family electricity bills or create water shortages. Supports policies that promote solar and battery storage to reduce electric bills and strengthen energy independence.
